t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Brown pink purple and yellow take you to the dark forest. Gnomes come on pairs, each other colour is paired with one of the ons i mentioned. The others take you to the bright forest.

vb_textbox.text: Brown, pink, yellow and orange take you to the dark forest.The other 4 take you to the light forest.The quantities of mushrooms in each forest seem to act like a sine wave, being high in one when they're low in the other.So, choose one of the forests to go to, and mind how the mushrooms trend upwards and downwards as you stick with that forest. As they dwindle downwards, choose the next round or two to switch to going to the other forest based upon my gnome-forest guide above.I used this strategy and seemed to get excellent results, as long as you stay focused I'm sure you can employ this strategy without the learning curve I experienced and you should therefore do a lot better than me from the get-go!Good luck!
